Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activity rows in assay CHEMBL4513082. Filter to exact measurements where standard_value is not null and standard_relation equals '='. Join activities to assays on assay_id, join activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno as an inner join. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
